name: Otowa Yuka
source:
A pretty girl in the same class as [url=https://vndb.org/c4700]Ryou[/url]. She has a bright, outgoing personality, but she pretends like she doesn't care about anything. She either does this to piss people off, or she's just plain terrible at interacting with others.

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/crescendo.html]JAST USA[/url]]
